people_also_viewed.name: Lisa Reagan
people_also_viewed.about:
Introduced as a “force of nature” by Cassandra Vieten, IONS president, at the first Mindful Motherhood Conference in NYC in 2011, Lisa Reagan’s passionate dedication to empower American activists, professionals, and families to envision and create a Wisdom-based, Wellness-informed Society has led to the founding of multiple inspired nonprofit initiatives and collaborations since her transformative motherhood initiation in 1997.

Lisa’s Mother-of-a-Quest began with co-founding a grassroots organization of Wayfinders, Trance-breakers, and New Cycle Makers fiercely intent on protecting American’s children by creating educational initiatives to counter the country’s freefall to the bottom of all wellness indicators among developed nations. Today, Kindred World is an award-winning nonprofit whose vision and mission are more relevant and critical than ever.

Integrating a quarter century of cultural transformation insights into grounded Wayfinder Wisdom, Lisa currently shepherds Kindred World in carrying out its ongoing nonprofit work through multiple initiatives and partner collaborations:

Kindred Media is an alternative media platform presenting the New Story of the Human Family. Lisa serves as Kindred’s executive editor. Our challenge, to bring visibility and coherence to cultural transformation, is achieved through Kindred Media’s holistic storytelling strategies.

The Evolved Nest, a virtual learning center featuring the award-winning science and research of Darcia Narvaez, PhD. Lisa and Darcia collaborate on the creation of educational projects, including the short film, Breaking the Cycle. Darcia Narvaez is ranked among the top 2% of scientists worldwide. Her research reveals our “evolutionary pathway to wellbeing”. Darcia currently serves as Kindred World’s president.

The Meet the Wayfinders Oral History Series was produced at the request of La Leche League International for their 65th Conference. This series integrates both Kindred’s New Story strategy as well as introducing the concept of Kindred Activism, which explores both how the advocates were successful and how their Wayfinder Wisdom can be duplicated. Kindred Activism is further explored in the Kindred Fellowship Program.

Lisa continues to shepherd Kindred World’s original vision of a Wisdom-based, Wellness-informed Society as the award-winning nonprofit serves Wayfinders, Trance-breakers, and New Cycle Makers, and expands its partnerships. See all of Kindred World’s initiatives at visit www.KindredWorld.org. To volunteer or partner with us, please contact Lisa at editor@kindredmedia.org.
